Paragraphe · A little blush for a little flush. Our…
blocks_element.text: A little blush for a little flush. Our on-the-go cream blush wakes up cheeks and lips with a satiny, diffused flush that melts on smoothly and stays all day. It’s a lightweight formula that hydrates skin for baby-soft cheeks and leaves a glowy finish without a greasy feel. Size: 5.3 g / 0.18 oz.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · • Long-wearing flush that won’t budge …
blocks_element.text:
• Long-wearing flush that won’t budge
• Hydrates skin for baby-soft cheeks
• Doesn’t leave a greasy or sticky feel

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Apply with your finger or a brush and …
blocks_element.text: Apply with your finger or a brush and tap onto cheeks. Color is buildable, so tap on a little or a lot—however you like it. For a monochromatic look, apply to cheeks and lips. Avoid the eye area.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · • For a monochromatic look, apply to c…
blocks_element.text:
• For a monochromatic look, apply to cheeks and lips
• For a glossy pout, apply to lips then top it off with a swipe of Peptide Lip Tint
• For a glazed finish, pat the tiniest bit of Peptide Glazing Fluid on top
